title: Model Subscription: refusals reach the customer in their language, a conversation moved to Tracy AI returns to the subscription once it can serve, and a batch from two speakers runs on the default instead of sticking the session
steps: S1: Start a throwaway Postgres and export TEST_DATABASE_URL (see tests/regression/README.md common setup or docs on tracy-web DB tests).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-concurrency=1 apps/tracy-web/test/seat-plan-route.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/seat-plan-broker.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-mode-picker/test/account-subscriptions.test.mjs
S3: Read the result of each test named below.
expect: 'the host's pin and run doors refuse in the account's language, not the default' passes.
'a conversation moved to Tracy AI goes back to the subscription once it can serve again' and 'a pin made with no connection stays plain after the account connects one' pass.
'a batch from two people runs on the deployment default and never asks the broker' passes.
'the host's own refusals carry no owner scope' passes.
fence: Route test calls the internal doors with a valid actor and an account whose language is vi; broker tests drive a real Postgres with a fallen-back pin whose cool-down then passes; host tests feed a two-speaker batch. No model, no network.

tests: the host's pin and run doors refuse in the account's language
a conversation moved to Tracy AI goes back to the subscription once it can serve again
a pin made with no connection stays plain after the account connects one
a batch from two people runs on the deployment default and never asks the broker
the host's own refusals carry no owner scope
